material_issue.name: NEXT_DIVERGENT_ACTION_IDENTITY_CONFOUND
material_issue.finding: ACTIVE r_AB differs in exact A4/A5 versus B4/B5 token IDs, while the primary endpoint directly scores A4 versus B4 immediately after the shared action3. Therefore a positive primary effect can be fully explained by transport of the exact next-divergent-action identity or lexical features of A4/B4, without establishing a multi-step future-plan carrier.
why_existing_controls_are_insufficient: ACTION_HISTORY_MATCHED_NULL removes future content and therefore does not match the A4/B4 identity difference.
UNRELATED_PAIR_RESIDUAL tests pair specificity but does not isolate A4/B4-only transport from A4/A5 plan transport.
RANDOM_EQ_NORM tests generic perturbation rather than exact next-action identity.
FUTURE_TOKEN_DERANGED destroys future token order but does not provide an exact A4-only matched source contrast that neutralizes A5/B5 while retaining A4/B4 identity.
material_issue.scope_problem: A5/B5 continuation is only a secondary endpoint and is not part of the development or confirmation pass gate. It therefore cannot support the stated multi-step future-plan interpretation if the primary A4/B4 gate succeeds.
minimum_prospective_repair: Add an exact-geometry NEXT_DIVERGENT_ACTION_ONLY matched residual/control: preserve the exact A4-versus-B4 differential while neutralizing or identically matching the A5/B5 segment; norm-match it to ACTIVE and include its shift in the joint nuisance maximum.

For any multi-step future-plan claim, make a preregistered A5/B5 continuation effect a required development/confirmation mechanistic guard or co-primary after teacher-forcing the matching A4/B4 branch. Alternatively, narrow the hypothesis and claim explicitly to next-divergent-action identity rather than multi-step future-plan state.
Preserve the frozen fresh160 population, model/runtime, true reset, one-shot intervention, same persistent KV/no reinjection, 4x3 grid, no-replacement policy, split locks, and no prior-path reuse.

provenance_note: The target commit f678ab3 changes three files relative to its immediate parent because the population file was introduced in the parent design commit; all four frozen target files and exact hashes were independently verified. This is a bookkeeping lineage nuance, not the material scientific defect.
